entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-07-09
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • DatabaseFacade.HasPendingModelChanges() false-positives on SQL Server temporal tables (PeriodStart/PeriodEnd) that the CLI correctly reports as clean #38602
  • SqlServer: KeyNotFoundException in RewriteOperations when a temporal table is renamed into the model's default schema #38601
  • Custom migration operations #38600
  • Cosmos: equality on a hierarchical partition-key prefix is lifted out of WHERE into the partition hint, forgoing the index and scanning the physical partition #38598

Closed

  • Migration dropping wrong Foreign Key on entities with same name but differemt schemas #35358
    11.0.0
  • Entity Framework Core generates a Foreign Key to the wrong table when using Entity Splitting #29915
    11.0.0
  • Owned entities FKs not matching PK casing on creation #37023
    11.0.0
  • Error when generating a new migration with SqlVector in EF 10 #38162
    11.0.0
  • Bundle generation failing when Central Package Management is configured #37006
    11.0.0
  • Throw by default for multiple owned entities set to the same instance #24614
    11.0.0
  • NullReferenceException in `IncludeJsonEntityCollection` with `UseLazyLoadingProxies()` + `OwnsMany().ToJson()` containing a primitive collection (works without proxies) #38466
    11.0.0
  • JSON serialised null values cause JsonCollectionReaderWriter to throw #34881
    11.0.0

PullRequests

Created

  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #38604
  • Cosmos: flow transactional batch failures through the execution strategy so they can be retried #38597
  • Warn and fix identity conflict when owned entity has inconsistent data in DB #38596
  • Honor startup `ProjectDepsFileName` / `ProjectRuntimeConfigFileName` in dotnet-ef host launch #38595
  • Prevent NRE when discriminator remains string but is configured with non-string store type #38593
  • Fix complex property projection for entity splitting mappings #38592
  • Cosmos: run query response status checks inside execution strategy retries #38591
  • Handle out-of-order split-include rows to prevent child collection loss under concurrent inserts #38590
  • Handle seed-data cycle diagnostics without crashing during migration scaffolding #38589
  • Fix Remove-Migration snapshot corruption for owned one-to-one relationships #38588
  • Fix ghost entry in EntityReferenceMap after identity conflict during Add #38587
  • Adjust migration operation ordering to avoid dropping in-use sequences during TPC sequence transitions #38583
  • Avoid false circular dependency edges for unchanged unique index values during update batching #38581

Merged

  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #38603
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #38568
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0' => 'release/10.0' #38567
  • Make the nullability marker survive GroupBy-element to-one subquery lowering #38577
    community-contribution
  • Fix FK diff matching across same table names in different schemas #38582
  • Fix FK to entity-split principal referencing wrong (fragment) table #38586
  • Propagate case-only principal string key updates to dependent FKs #38585
  • SQLite: Ensure Deactivate does not use disposed handle on return #38574
  • Prevent `FindCollectionMapping` NRE on legacy string/vector snapshot mappings #38594
  • Handle `migrations bundle` temp project generation when Central Package Management is enabled #38584
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #38599

Updated

  • Update SQLitePCLRaw package versions for Sqlite packages and skip affected SQLite query test #38605
  • Align SQLite package graph to SQLitePCLRaw 3.0.3/3.53.3 and retire e_sqlite3mc test target #38606
  • Fix AssertAllMethodsOverridden for XUnit V3 Fact/Theory #38570
  • Discover the migrations-bundle DbContext out-of-process so publish doesn't lock the assembly #38456
    community-contribution
